organizations.What they build: Open-source AI platform. Its Paris-based robotics team builds LeRobot (open-source library to record data, train and run robot policies such as ACT, pi0 and SmolVLA on cheap arms like the SO-101) and, since acquiring Pollen Robotics (Bordeaux), sells open robots such as Reachy Mini and Reachy 2.
organizations.Warm contact path: 42AI already co-hosted the June 2025 LeRobot worldwide hackathon with Hugging Face at 42 Paris (https://42-ai.github.io/posts/LeRobotHackathon/)

organizations.What they build: Self-balancing exoskeletons (Atalante X used at 150+ clinical and research sites; Eve personal exoskeleton) and, since 2025, the Calvin-40 industrial humanoid developed with Renault. Opened a robot production site in Paris.

Mirokaï social robots (Miroki and Miroka): manga-style robots with a head and two arms riding on a motorised ball, deployed in hospitals, nursing homes, hotels and Lyon airport. Founded 2021 by ex-Aldebaran Jérôme Monceaux; Google DeepMind Gemini trusted tester.

Lightweight, low-cost general-purpose humanoid robots (Northstar design, Version 0 prototype, designed and assembled in Paris). Co-founded by Rémi Cadène, ex-Tesla Optimus and former lead of Hugging Face LeRobot.
organizations.Warm contact path: Via the Hugging Face LeRobot team (Cadène's former team)

organizations.What they build: Full-stack general-purpose robotics company: GENE-26.5 robot foundation model, human-like dexterous robotic hands and the Eno wheeled robot. Co-founded by Zhou Xian (creator of the Genesis physics simulator) and Théophile Gervet; Station F Future 40 (2025).

Frontier AI lab co-founded by Yann LeCun building world models (JEPA-style AI that understands the physical world) for industrial control, automation, wearables and robotics. Raised $1.03B in March 2026.

French LLM company that entered robotics in July 2026 with Robostral Navigate, an 8B single-camera navigation model trained on simulated data with RL; organised a Physical AI & Robotics hackathon in Paris (April 2025) with Hugging Face LeRobot.
Synthetic data platform for physical AI: describe a 3D scene, vary it millions of ways and get perfect ground truth for training robot/vision models. Raised $10M seed (Inovia) in Nov 2026.

AI that teaches industrial humanoid robots new factory tasks from a few demonstrations (under an hour). Inria spin-off (HUCEBOT team, Serena Ivaldi); €5M pre-seed in Oct 2026; Station F Future 40 2026.
Autonomous robots for existing (brownfield) warehouses: picking, sorting, palletizing, container unloading, packing. Founded 2025; Station F Future 40 2025.
Modular warehouse robotics: TAK-ONE system that slides parcels and bins horizontally and vertically across levels (compact buffer/sorting). €10M round in 2025 (Supernova Invest, Bpifrance).

Real-time 3D vision and a generalist AI model that let industrial robot arms locate parts and adapt trajectories (GuideNOW-type sensor on the robot wrist; integrated in the Universal Robots ecosystem). €15M Series A 2024, €11M in 2026.
3D LiDAR SLAM software (Exwayz Engine): mapping, centimetre localization and perception for robots and autonomous vehicles, CPU-only. CentraleSupélec 21st accelerator; €1M raised.
Microrobots the size of a grain of rice that travel inside the brain for minimally invasive neurosurgery. Founded 2017 in Paris; based at AP-HP Hôtel-Dieu; $28M raised in 2025.
Maestro surgical-assistant robot for laparoscopy (holds and moves instruments for the surgeon); 2026 software update turned it into a 'physical AI' platform. Backed by Sofinnova and Cathay Health.
Marker-less robotic assistant for total knee arthroplasty (orthopaedic surgery), under development (not yet cleared).
Swan: robot that captures standardized full-body dermoscopic skin images for early skin-cancer detection. Raised $18M in 2026 (Sonder Capital, Deeptech 2030 Fund).

AI-piloted autonomous drones (interceptors, strike and reconnaissance), radar/EW payloads and command software. Founded 2024, French defence unicorn; $200M Series B led by Dassault Aviation (Jan 2026).
Modular autonomous underwater vehicles (low-cost subsea drone swarms) for fleet defence. Founded 2025; Y Combinator P26; Station F Future 40 2026.
Real-time low-latency (≈8 ms) infrastructure for robot teleoperation, monitoring, training-data collection and human takeover; founded by VLC lead developer Jean-Baptiste Kempf; open-source strategy.
Agentic 'common brain' / OS that orchestrates fleets of heterogeneous robots and devices through natural language.
Teaching infrastructure that trains existing robot models on customer-specific jobs they fail at (XR + 3D computer vision).
Collaborative robots for industrial sanding/finishing; CEA-List spin-off; €7M raised in Feb 2026.
Autonomous forklift robots (AGV/AMR hybrids with LiDAR navigation) built on OEM chassis; 2025 sales €31.4M.
Goods-to-person warehouse robots (mobile robots carrying shelves to pickers); founded 2013, HQ and R&D in Paris.
Outdoor logistics robots (autonomous car-parking/vehicle-moving robots); founded 2015, HQ Paris.
Continues NAO (and Aldebaran legacy) development after Maxvision bought Aldebaran's core assets in July 2025; social humanoids for research, education and healthcare.
Drones, now mainly professional/defence micro-UAVs such as ANAFI UKR (sovereign ISR micro-drone, 2025).
Event-based (neuromorphic) vision sensors and software: cameras that only report pixel changes, giving very low latency perception for robots and drones.
Infrastructure-based physical AI: 3D LiDAR software that tracks people/vehicle flows in airports, factories and cities.
Maritime robotics (drones/underwater vehicles) and inertial navigation systems; high-tech industrial group.

IT/engineering services group; tests Unitree robots with Orano for operations in radioactive zones.

summary: Who leads: Hugging Face (LeRobot, Reachy) and Wandercraft (exoskeletons, Calvin-40 humanoid) anchor Paris robotics; a 2025-26 wave of robot-learning startups (Genesis AI, UMA, Bleu Robotics, AMI Labs, Mistral's Robostral) makes Paris a physical-AI software hub.

Where money is: frontier AI/world models (AMI Labs $1.03B), defence autonomy (Harmattan AI $200M Series B, Rift, AICE), humanoids/exoskeletons (Wandercraft €64.3M) and medical robots (Moon Surgical, Robeauté, SquareMind); Bpifrance/Supernova back logistics hardware.

Where demand is: hospitals and care (exoskeletons, social robots, surgical assistants), factories (Renault humanoids, Inbolt vision, ISYBOT cobots) and warehouses (BALYO, Galam, Scallog, Marso); defence demand is strong but a poor fit for us.

Gap/opportunity: Paris is strong in AI software and weak in affordable hardware and student-accessible labs; mechanics remains our weak spot, so partner with hardware startups and research labs (ISIR, Inria, CEA-List) for mentoring.

Best entry point: the Hugging Face LeRobot team and community in Paris (already co-hosted a 2025 hackathon with 42AI), plus Station F events with Unaite/GOSIM/Mistral hackathons; ship open SO-101 imitation-learning projects and datasets to get noticed.
